verses.ala-da-wa-l-fata-humqun-wajahlun-c1-v1: ʾalā daʿwā l-fatā ḥumqu wajahlu wayaʾamanu makra mawlānā jahūlu
verses.ala-da-wa-l-fata-humqun-wajahlun-c1-v2: maqāmu l-ʿabdi dhullu wāmtihānu tadhallal kay tujānisa yā dhalīlu
verses.ala-da-wa-l-fata-humqun-wajahlun-c1-v3: ʾishāratu ḥubbihi jibrīlu dallat kafā hadhā liman lahumu l-ʿuqūlu
